preparation.base: Conda osx-64 environment (htslib, boost-cpp, libdeflate, zlib, bzip2, cmake, make, clang/clang++) building unmodified upstream vamos v3.1.1 from source
preparation.without_preparation: Automated verification stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` uses a shell glob (`cd vamos*/src/ && make`) that the automated engine does not expand, and references an external Zenodo motif catalog not bundled in the repository.
why: Automated verification stopped before installation (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) because `README.md` writes `cd vamos*/src/ && make` (with a wildcard path) and shows an example reading a Zenodo motif catalog not present in the repository.

`src/Makefile` compiles bundled `abPOA-1.4.1` with `sse2=true` (x86_64 SIMD) and links against `$(CONDA_PREFIX)/lib` (`htslib`, `zlib`, `bzip2`, `libdeflate`). On Apple Silicon, building in an `osx-64` conda environment with `CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` and `-Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types` (for `parasail`'s test target under Clang 22) compiles the unmodified upstream source cleanly.

Although `vamos --read` ran to completion (exit 0) and produced 20 locus records, `src/vcf.cpp` (lines 104-122) unconditionally appends a trailing `;` to the `INFO` column and emits `GT=1/2` against a single `ALT=<VNTR>` allele, causing strict VCF structural validation (`strhub-vcf-structure/1`) to fail at line 209 (`invalid or duplicate INFO key`).
steps: Cloned `https://github.com/ChaissonLab/vamos` at commit `5c4a069847fbe6ca6067de1bff6098c9403db9ec` without modifying any file in the checkout.

Created an isolated `osx-64` conda environment (`htslib`, `boost-cpp`, `libdeflate`, `zlib`, `bzip2`, `cmake`, `make`, `clang_osx-64`, `clangxx_osx-64`) and built `vamos` in a separate build copy (`src/Makefile`, with `CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5` and `-Wno-error=incompatible-pointer-types` for `parasail-2.6.2`).

Added the conda library rpath (`install_name_tool -add_rpath`) so macOS dyld resolves `libhts.3.dylib`, and staged the indexed ONT R10 SUP CODIS BAM (`HG00113.codis.bam` + `.bai`) and 4-column `motif.bed` in `/data/in`.

Executed `vamos --read -b /data/in/sample.bam -r /data/in/motif.bed -s HG00113 -o /data/out/sample.vcf -t 4` (exit 0, 20 records written) and ran STRhub's strict VCF structural check (`strhub-vcf-structure/1`), which rejected `sample.vcf` on line 209.

recommendations: Remove the trailing semicolon at the end of the `INFO` field in `src/vcf.cpp` (lines 117, 121, and 129) so `INFO` entries do not end with an empty key after `;`.

Align `ALT` and `GT` in `src/vcf.cpp` (lines 104-110): when emitting heterozygous `GT=1/2`, declare two distinct `ALT` alleles (or use a VCF-conformant representation matching the number of alleles in `ALT`) so strict VCF parsers (`strhub-vcf-structure/1`, GATK, `vcf-validator`) accept the output.

Replace `cd vamos*/src/ && make` in `README.md` with an explicit relative path (`cd src && make`) and document a minimal test command using the bundled `example/demo.aln.bam` and `example/one_region_motif.bed`.

verdict.title: Fails in manual verification
verdict.reason: Built unmodified upstream vamos v3.1.1 (`5c4a069`) from source in an isolated `osx-64` conda environment (zero source modifications) and ran `vamos --read` against the HG00113 Oxford Nanopore R10 SUP CODIS reference slice (`ont-bam-hg38`, 20 CODIS loci in 4-column `motif.bed` format). Execution completed cleanly in <1 s (exit 0) and emitted calls for all 20/20 loci in `sample.vcf`, but the `Expected IO` gate (`strhub-vcf-structure/1`) failed because `src/vcf.cpp` writes non-conformant VCF records: every `INFO` column ends with a trailing semicolon (`LEN_H1=...;` / `LEN_H2=...;`, creating an empty INFO key), and heterozygous loci emit `GT=1/2` while `ALT` declares only one symbolic allele (`<VNTR>`).

es.plain_why: vamos v3.1.1 compila desde el código fuente y corre de punta a punta en los 20/20 loci CODIS (código de salida 0), pero falla la validación estricta de VCF (`Expected IO`) por un punto y coma al final de `INFO` y por emitir `GT=1/2` con un solo alelo en `ALT=<VNTR>` (`src/vcf.cpp`).
es.without_preparation: La verificación automática se detuvo antes de la instalación (`UNVERIFIED_INSUFFICIENT_DOCS`) porque `README.md` usa un comodín de shell (`cd vamos*/src/ && make`) que el motor automático no expande, y referencia un catálogo externo de Zenodo que no está incluido en el repositorio.
recommendations: Quitar el punto y coma final de la columna `INFO` en `src/vcf.cpp` (líneas 117, 121 y 129) para que `INFO` no termine con una clave vacía después de `;`.

Alinear `ALT` y `GT` en `src/vcf.cpp` (líneas 104-110): al emitir heterocigotas `GT=1/2`, declarar dos alelos distintos en `ALT` (o usar una representación conforme al estándar VCF que coincida con la cantidad de alelos en `ALT`) para que parsers estrictos de VCF (`strhub-vcf-structure/1`, GATK, `vcf-validator`) acepten la salida.

Reemplazar `cd vamos*/src/ && make` en `README.md` por una ruta relativa explícita (`cd src && make`) y documentar un comando mínimo de prueba usando los archivos ya incluidos `example/demo.aln.bam` y `example/one_region_motif.bed`.
